leftEvidence.title: Cain and Abel enter Adam’s family story

points.label: Family sequence
points.left: The man and Eve become parents; Cain and Abel work the ground and flock, bring offerings, and the brothers’ story moves toward Abel’s death.
points.right: Adam and Eve have another son, Eve names Seth tied to Abel’s death, and Seth’s son belongs to the generation that begins calling on the LORD’s name.

points.label: Source setting
points.left: Children, generations, and death · family context · Genesis 4:1–8
points.right: Children, generations, and death · core · Genesis 4:25–26

payload.posture: The first brothers’ story ends in death; Seth is later named through Abel’s loss.

rightEvidence.title: Adam and Eve receive Seth after Abel

payload.tension: Adam’s family continues, but the later birth keeps the murdered brother in view.
payload.title: Adam’s household before and after Abel’s death
